job.title: Senior Power Apps Developer
job.description:
Contract | Senior Power Platform Developer | Microsoft Consultancy | Enterprise Delivery

**URGENT HIRE**

A boutique Microsoft consultancy is looking for a Senior Power Platform Developer to join an enterprise customer project delivering modern Microsoft solutions.
Working closely with customer stakeholders, you'll take ownership of a workforce planning and resource management solution using Microsoft Power Platform technologies from solution design through to implementation.

You'll work across
  • Power Apps
  • Power Automate
  • SharePoint Online
  • Dataverse
  • Dynamics 365
  • Azure
  • Power BI
  • Microsoft 365

We're looking for someone with
  • Strong commercial Power Platform experience
  • Microsoft Partner or consultancy background
  • Enterprise customer delivery experience
  • Solution architecture capability
  • Strong stakeholder management skills
  • Azure integration experience
  • Experience leading technical delivery
  • Ability to work independently within a customer-facing consulting environment

This is an immediate contract opportunity offering the chance to work on a high-profile enterprise project with a growing Microsoft consultancy. If you enjoy solving business problems, working directly with customers and delivering modern Microsoft solutions, we'd love to hear from you.
